categories.main_business_segments: Y2 Solution Co., Ltd primarily develops and manufactures Power Supply Units (PSU) used in electronic devices, with a focus on display TVs including UHD, OLED, and QNED models. The company also operates a chemical product wholesale business supplying basic chemical raw materials. Additionally, it is nurturing new growth businesses in power modules for electric vehicle (EV) fast chargers and biopharmaceutical drug development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology centers on PSU development using power semiconductor MOSFET switches to optimize DC and AC voltage for electronic product reliability. It has developed ultra-slim PSU technology for premium TVs and is advancing high-capacity, high-output PSU modules for EV chargers. Production involves PCB and transformer assembly with manufacturing facilities in Korea, China, and Vietnam. The company also pursues R&D collaborations with universities and government projects to secure next-generation and foundational technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major electronics manufacturers, notably LG Electronics, for whom Y2 Solution supplies PSU modules for a wide range of display TVs. The chemical wholesale business serves diverse industries such as paint, ink, adhesives, pharmaceuticals, and electronics by supplying basic chemical raw materials. The EV power module business targets domestic and international EV fast charger manufacturers. The biopharmaceutical segment focuses on unmet medical needs, developing cell therapies for dry age-related macular degeneration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Gyeonggi Province and other domestic locations. It also has production sites in Qingdao, China, and Hanoi, Vietnam, supporting global supply chains. Its chemical products are imported from Japan, China, and Europe and distributed domestically. The biopharmaceutical development targets global markets, including the U.S., through a joint venture with a U.S.-based neural stem cell institute.
categories.supply_chain_position: Y2 Solution operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing critical PSU components for OEMs like LG Electronics. In chemicals, it functions as a distributor between large petrochemical manufacturers and end users. The company is expanding downstream into EV charger power modules and upstream into biopharmaceutical drug development through joint ventures and partnerships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening its leadership in premium display PSU technology and expanding into high-power PSU modules for EV fast chargers. It invests heavily in R&D to develop next-generation PSU products and collaborates with universities and government projects. The biopharmaceutical segment pursues early-stage drug candidates via open innovation and global partnerships. Although it has added AI imaging and telemedicine business purposes, it currently does not actively pursue these areas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of PSU modules to major electronics manufacturers and wholesale distribution of chemical products. The company also earns revenue from emerging biopharmaceutical drug development activities, though these are in early stages. Export sales constitute a significant portion of PSU revenue, while chemical sales are mostly domestic. The company does not currently rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Y2 Solution is a leading PSU module specialist in South Korea, particularly recognized for supplying LG Electronics’ premium TV models. The PSU market is competitive with many domestic players, but only a few produce high-end PSU modules for UHD, OLED, and QNED TVs. The company maintains a strong market position through high-efficiency, high-capacity, and high-quality products. In chemicals, it competes as a distributor among multiple large petrochemical suppliers. The EV charger power module and biopharmaceutical markets are emerging with new competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Y2 Solution reported revenues of approximately KRW 137 billion, a 13.6% increase from the prior year, with operating profit of KRW 1.9 billion. The company has a capital base of about KRW 91.4 billion following a 5:1 stock consolidation in 2023. Production capacity and output have increased with new investments in China and Vietnam. Despite challenges from global TV market stagnation, the company improved operational efficiency and cost competitiveness, positioning for growth in premium PSU and EV charger segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Y2 Solution emphasizes its advanced ultra-slim PSU technology for premium TVs, offering superior efficiency, capacity, and quality that support the longevity and reliability of electronic products. Its close collaboration with LG Electronics ensures tailored solutions across a broad product range. The company’s expansion into high-power PSU modules for EV fast chargers leverages its core competencies to capture emerging markets. In biopharmaceuticals, it differentiates by focusing on early-stage, unmet medical needs with innovative cell therapy approaches developed through global partnerships.
